title: Verify settlement totals by merchant
sqlValidation:
SELECT
    m.id,
    m.merchantName,
    COUNT(s.merchantId) AS settlementCount,
    COALESCE(SUM(s.amount),0) AS settlementTotal
FROM dbo.Merchants m
LEFT JOIN dbo.Settlements s ON s.merchantId = m.id
GROUP BY m.id, m.merchantName
ORDER BY m.id;
sqlExpectedResult: Every settlement total is attached to the correct merchant and no orphan merchantId exists.
